evidence: A commenter recommended Michael D. Gordin’s book for its account of languages used in science over time.

evidence_sources.author: rhodin
evidence_sources.excerpt: I'd also recommend "Scientific Babel How Science Was Done Before and After Global English" by Michael D. Gordin [0]. It goes into detail about which languages scientists have used over time. [0] https://press.uchicago.edu/ucp/books/book/chicago/S/bo145049...
